backpack.definition:
n. a bag carried by a strap on your back or shoulder
v. hike with a backpack
backpack.translation: n. 远足用的背包；双肩背包, 背包

backpacked.translation:
n. 双肩背包，背包；远足用的背包
vt. 挑运；把…放入背包
vi. 背负简便行李旅行；挑运

backpacker.definition: n. a hiker who wears a backpack

backpackers.definition:
plural of backpacker
n. a hiker who wears a backpack
backpackers.translation: (backpacker 的复数) n. 背包旅行者

backpacking.definition:
n carrying something in a pack on the back
v hike with a backpack

backpacks.definition:
n. a bag carried by a strap on your back or shoulder
v. hike with a backpack
backpacks.translation: n. （指登山者、步行者使用或背小孩时使用的）背包, （有轻金属框的）箱形背包( backpack的复数形式 )

backpat.translation:
v. 拍(…)肩背以示赞许
n. ( 表示赞许等的)拍肩, 赞许表示

backpedal.definition:
v. pedal backwards on a bicycle
v. step backwards, in boxing
v. modify one's opinion, make it less strong
backpedal.translation: vi. 倒踏脚踏板, 后退, 变卦

backpedaled.translation: vi. 倒踏脚踏板；（拳击中的）后退；（意见等的）撤回；变卦

backpedaling.translation: vi. 倒踏脚踏板；（拳击中的）后退；（意见等的）撤回；变卦

backpedalled.translation: v. 改变主意, 变卦, 背弃诺言( backpedal的过去式和过去分词 )

backpedalling.translation: v. 改变主意, 变卦, 背弃诺言( backpedal的现在分词 )

backpedals.definition:
v pedal backwards on a bicycle
v step backwards, in boxing
v modify one's opinion, make it less strong
backpedals.translation: v. 改变主意, 变卦, 背弃诺言( backpedal的第三人称单数 )

backplate.definition: n. plate armor protecting the back; worn as part of a cuirass

backproject.translation:
n. 幕后放映的影像
v. 幕后放映

backprojection.translation: 幕后投影; 背景放映
